The presence of multiple distinct targets for Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3 indicates that Octyl valerate may influence multiple pathways, potentially through different mechanisms. While the evidence is consistent, the exact nature of the interaction and its biological relevance remain areas of uncertainty, requiring further experimental validation.
